column1: # What the differential test compares, and where each file came from.
# Columns: role, source (commit:path, or the path in this repo), sha256 of the text (CR removed).
# The rolling dev pre-release (tag dev, commit 3db7b5e, core pin ee8cc72) is the only build this repo
# has published; there is no v* tag and no predecessor repo. No release ZIP or launcher manifest
# shipped or seeded a HeadTracking.ini: every player's file is the one WriteDefaultConfigIfMissing
# wrote on the first run, edited or not. The reader was frozen at a128a2e, whose src/ matches dev's
# byte for byte, and every core source either reader compiles holds the same bytes at ee8cc72 and at
# the current pin, so comparison 1 is empty by construction.

column2: the file the dev build's WriteDefaultConfigIfMissing writes (dev:src/config.cpp, text mode, so CRLF), tests/config_differential/data/first-run-dev.ini; the test checks the oracle still writes these bytes
